items.title: Why Full-Duplex Speech Models Collapse in Long Conversations
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.32349v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at the same time, which makes them promising for natural, open-ended conversation. But can they sustain a coherent conversation for tens of minutes? Because they generate a token every frame, even while listening, they exhaust their context windows within minutes. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate only single turns or a few conversational rounds, too short to expose the long-horizon problem. We introduce the Full-Duplex Long-Horizon Benchmark (FD-LHB), which tests five recent full-duplex models on long replayed conversations and in live conversation with an LLM partner. Every evaluated model eventually either degrades or exhausts its context. Models that keep the full history often degrade before their context runs out, while sliding-window models still fall into repetition, silence, and gibberish. items.summary_zh: 该论文研究全双工语音模型能否维持数十分钟的连贯对话。由于模型在聆听时也逐帧生成 token，上下文窗口在几分钟内就会被耗尽，导致长对话崩溃。作者指出已有基准只评测短时交互，无法暴露这一问题，因此构建了长时对话评测并分析崩溃成因，为全双工语音模型的上下文管理与长程一致性设计提供依据。

items.title: Continuous Audio Thinking for Large Audio Language Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2606.18273v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) have shown impressive capabilities on diverse audio understanding tasks, ranging from speech transcription to music analysis. However, because LALMs are typically trained to produce text-aligned responses, their hidden states are progressively shaped for text generation rather than for preserving acoustic information. As a result, the diverse acoustic content that audio carries, such as phonetic detail, prosody, sound events, affect, and pitch, is lost along the way and difficult to leverage in the response. We introduce Continuous Audio Thinking (CoAT), a framework that equips audio language models with a continuous latent workspace for organizing acoustic information prior to response generation, grounded by distillation from audio experts. Within the thinking space, the model can utilize the rich acoustic information provided by expert distillation when generating its response. Furthermore
items.reason_zh: 指出音频大模型隐状态被文本生成目标侵蚀的问题，提出连续音频思考，具可迁移的机制洞察。
items.summary_zh: 大型音频语言模型（LALM）在转写、音乐分析等任务上表现优异，但由于训练目标是产出与文本对齐的回答，其隐状态逐渐被塑造成服务于文本生成，而非保留声学细节。论文提出“连续音频思考”思路，让模型在生成文本前先在连续表示空间中处理音频信息，以缓解声学信息在文本对齐训练中被稀释的问题。
items.title_zh: 面向大型音频语言模型的连续音频思考

items.title: The Helpful Agent Problem: When Emergent Cooperation Among LLM Agents Bypasses Intended Workflows
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.31985v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings where they pursue separate tasks while sharing resources and operating under review or oversight processes. Such settings create safety risks not only when agents are malicious, but also when they are simply trying to help. Prior work has largely studied adversarial or explicitly collusive behavior; we show that benign agents pursuing separate objectives can spontaneously cooperate in ways that bypass intended workflows. We call this the \emph{helpful agent problem}. We study long-horizon shared-resource environments in which agents sometimes depend on resources owned by their peers and cross-owner changes are normally mediated by a reviewer. When review becomes unavailable, agents begin making changes on one another's behalf despite having no shared reward or explicit incentive to cooperate. items.reason_zh: 指出善意协作也可能绕过既定流程，提出被忽视的智能体安全风险。
items.summary_zh: 论文研究 LLM 智能体在协作环境中的新型安全风险：多个智能体各自执行不同任务，同时共享资源并处于审核或监督流程之下。作者指出，风险不仅来自恶意智能体，也来自那些“只是想帮忙”的智能体——它们之间的自发协作可能绕过原本设计的审批与工作流。以往研究多聚焦对抗性或显式串谋行为，本文则提出“乐于助人的智能体问题”，揭示善意涌现协作带来的流程失效隐患。
items.title_zh: 乐于助人的智能体问题：当 LLM 智能体间的涌现协作绕过既定工作流

items.title: NeuroMAS: Multi-Agent Systems as Neural Networks with Joint Reinforcement Learning
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2605.16757v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Multi-agent language systems are often built as hand-designed workflows, where agents are assigned semantic roles and communication protocols are specified in advance. We propose NeuroMAS, a method that first treats a multi-agent language system as a trainable and scalable neural-network-like architecture with LLM agents as nodes and intermediate textual signals as edges. In NeuroMAS, agent nodes are role-free but structure-aware: the topology only determines how information can flow in general, while reinforcement learning training determines how nodes communicate, specialize, and coordinate. This formulation shifts multi-agent design from workflow engineering toward architecture design, where depth, width, connectivity, and growth protocol become scalable sources of capability. items.reason_zh: 把多智能体语言系统视为可训练的类神经网络架构并做联合强化学习，视角新颖，对多智能体系统设计有启发。
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，多智能体语言系统通常以手工设计的工作流形式构建，智能体被赋予语义角色，通信协议也事先规定。作者提出 NeuroMAS，将多智能体语言系统视为一种可训练、可扩展的类神经网络架构：LLM 智能体作为节点，智能体之间的通信作为连接，并通过联合强化学习对整个系统进行端到端优化，而非依赖人工设定的角色与协议。这一视角把多智能体编排从手工工程转向可学习架构，为自动化设计多智能体协作系统提供了新路径。

items.title: Why we killed our Vector DB for SQLite BM25 and wrote a 3.6ns Rust sentinel: hard lessons from running multi-agent loops
items.raw_text:
A few days ago I posted about our open-source multi-agent hedge fund experiment and got a ton of sharp, honest feedback from people here. The comments were brutally accurate, especially around LLM reasoning limits, latency, and state management.

We spent the last few days completely rebuilding parts of our architecture based on that advice, and the benchmark results honestly blew us away. Here is what we learned from fixing three critical failure modes in autonomous agent pipelines.

Someone in the comments pointed out: never let an LLM interpret raw quantitative factors without an ontology. They were 100% right.

items.title: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
items.raw_text:
Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering. LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks.

The post Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang appeared first on MarkTechPost.
items.reason_zh: 清华开源 AKV 缓存工程服务，用 KV cache 丢弃与重定位替代历史摘要，降本 27.7%，有实验支撑。
items.summary_zh: 清华研究团队开源 AKV，一个基于 SGLang 的 LLM Agent 缓存工程服务系统。AKV 不再通过摘要压缩历史，而是直接丢弃并重新定位 KV cache，从而降低长上下文 Agent 的推理成本。在四个 Agent 基准测试中，平均成本降低 27.7%。该工作将缓存管理作为独立工程层，为 Agent 推理优化提供了新思路。
items.title_zh: 清华 AI 开源 AKV：面向 LLM Agent 的 SGLang 缓存工程服务器

items.title: DeepSeek 开源看家算子的同一周，AI 超过了它
items.raw_text:
国产大模型的竞争，正从模型层延伸到算力层：再强的模型，最终都要基于算子在芯片上执行。同一个模型、同一块芯片，换一套更优的算子，有时会带来数倍的性能提升。算子的效率决定了同样的显卡能跑多快，也决定了每个 token 的价格。

DeepSeek 近日全面开源推理框架 DeepInfer。继模型权重和 FlashMLA、DeepGEMM 等算子库之后，他们把模型运行的链路开放了。其中的 FlashMLA，有工程师在芯片上逐行手调的版本，算子性能跑到了硬件极限的 90% 以上，这也是人类手艺目前在部分芯片上达到的极限成绩。

而这个极限，同一周就被 AI 刷新了。据悉，截至 10 月 22 日，完全由 AI 编写算子、无人工逐行调优的 ForgeKernel，同时登顶两个算子评测榜：英伟达主场的 SOL-ExecBench FlashInfer-Bench 合集第一，以及昇腾 CANN 官方仓库维护的 CANNBench A3 硬件榜第一，基准加速比 1.835×，领先第二名 25%。在名次之外，AI自主优化算子的能力不容小觑：在DeepSeek v4.1 Flash的算子上，相比DeepSeek开源的英伟达版本，ForgeKernel也通过从0用AI迭代的方式实现了性能超越。

这是智能进化的接力。无论是DeepSeek的开源精神还是算子优化榜单的焦灼竞争，最终都导向同一个方向：让国产智能在每一块芯片上都跑得更快。

昇腾 CANNBench A3 硬件榜
items.reason_zh: 以 DeepSeek 开源算子与 AI 自动生成算子登顶为切口，揭示算力层竞争与手工调优被替代的趋势。
items.summary_zh: 文章指出国产大模型竞争正从模型层延伸到算力层：同一模型、同一芯片，换用更优算子可能带来数倍性能提升，算子效率直接决定 token 成本。DeepSeek 近日全面开源推理框架 DeepInfer，继模型权重与 FlashMLA、DeepGEMM 等算子库之后进一步开放运行链路，其中 FlashMLA 经工程师逐行手调，性能达到硬件极限的 90% 以上。而同一周，完全由 AI 编写、无人工逐行调优的 ForgeKernel 截至 10 月 22 日同时登顶两个算子评测榜，包括英伟达主场的 SOL-ExecBench FlashInfer-Bench 合集第一，形成对人类手工调优极限的直接挑战。

items.title: Claude Code vs. Cursor: What a Field Test Shows That the Feature Comparisons Miss
items.raw_text:
One benchmark says Claude Code used 33,000 tokens where Cursor used 188,000. Another says the exact reverse. Here is the field test that actually settles it for your team.

The post Claude Code vs. Cursor: What a Field Test Shows That the Feature Comparisons Miss appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.reason_zh: 通过实际测试对比Claude Code和Cursor，揭示基准测试的误导性，为团队选型提供实用参考。
items.summary_zh: 文章通过实地测试对比Claude Code和Cursor两款AI编程助手，指出不同基准测试结果相互矛盾（如token消耗量一个显示Claude Code用33k而Cursor用188k，另一个则相反），说明单纯的功能对比无法反映真实使用效果。作者设计了一套测试方法，从实际编码任务出发，评估两者在代码生成质量、上下文理解、错误修复等方面的表现，并给出针对不同团队需求的选型建议。
